primary_source.read_depth: Complete main Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion and all six figure captions. Images 2, 4 and 5 inspected; other downloaded images not visually reviewed. No raw-data reanalysis.

failed_supplement_request.status: XML error response, not a valid supplementary archive

model.context: J20 APP mice with excess neural stem-cell division and later pool depletion, compared with nontransgenic littermates
model.allocation: Semirandom by birth order, balanced age, sex and genotype; no formal randomization

protein_arm.name: Recombinant sFRP3
protein_arm.exposure: 120 ng/day continuous intracerebroventricular infusion for 14 days beginning at one month
protein_arm.endpoint: Ki67-positive fraction among Nestin-positive neural stem cells
unmeasured: Long-term stem-cell preservation in the infused-protein arm

current_listing.identity: Current recombinant human research sFRP3 product
current_listing.historical_equivalence: Not established; do not assign this catalog number to the study

AAV_arm.followup: Approximately 2.5 months after injection at age one month
AAV_arm.pool_preservation: Total Nestin-positive pool retained with lower proliferating fraction; Figure4I/J, n6–9 mice/group
AAV_arm.immature_neuron_null: DCX neuroblast and immature-neuron counts not rescued; APP contrasts P=.83 and P=.766

behavior.reported_comparison: Paired training versus test within each group
behavior.limit: Difference of significance is not a treatment interaction; no validated between-treatment behavioral effect size inferred.

spines.unit_limit: Multiple dendrite segments per mouse; tests do not describe mouse-level clustering
spines.disease_specificity: Some spine effects also present in nontransgenic animals

AAV_arm.EEG: Within-group time comparisons do not establish a treatment-by-time antiseizure benefit.

levetiracetam_arm.exposure: 75 mg/kg intraperitoneally three times daily for 14 days from 1.5 months
levetiracetam_arm.positive: Higher Frzb RNA in treated APP group; Figure2E P=.037
levetiracetam_arm.excluded: Two treated APP mice excluded because seizure burden did not decrease
levetiracetam_arm.n: Caption literal 36 per group conflicts with points and ANOVA degrees of freedom; not silently converted to presumed 3–6
levetiracetam_arm.interpretation: Selected-responder RNA result, not all-treated effect or newly measured cognition/BUBR1 benefit
levetiracetam_arm.earlier_work: Earlier cited levetiracetam functional work not newly reviewed or counted as replication here

other_administered_roles.kainic_acid_and_pilocarpine: Seizure induction, not rescue leads in this paper
other_administered_roles.ancillary_agents: Scopolamine, terbutaline, ethosuximide, diazepam and supportive fluids have protocol/support roles; no separate qualified efficacy arm here

BUBR1_context: Earlier hypomorphic BubR1 models start with deficient division and benefit from genetic sFRP3 reduction; J20 APP starts with excess division and is studied with sFRP3 addition. Read the actual defect before choosing direction. Earlier qualified genetic evidence is preserved; cited Cho2019 has not been newly read here.
decision: Add protein as a direction-dependent research reagent and levetiracetam as a seizure-context comparator. Neither establishes MVA efficacy or displaces either provisional nominee.

followup_of.status: Bounded primary qualification now available; clinical transfer and specified source questions remain open
